sentences.en: I've been through the same drawn-out process as you, so we can commiserate.
sentences.zh: 我和你经历过同样的漫长过程，所以我们可以互相怜悯一下。

sentences.en: We should commiserate over the tough job market these days.
sentences.zh: 我们应该为如今艰难的就业市场而感到同情。

sentences.en: I really don't know how to commiserate with someone who won the lottery.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道该怎样去安慰中了彩票的人。
